name: What should I look for when visiting a new construction condo sales center in Miami?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when visiting a new construction condo sales center in Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: When visiting a new construction sales center, focus on examining the floor plans, finish samples, and model units closely. Pay attention to the quality of materials, appliance brands, and available upgrade options. A practical tradeoff is that while models show an ideal finish, some standard inclusions might be less luxurious, requiring additional investment for upgrades. It's important to ask about HOA fees, included amenities, and developer reputation. Kelby Contreras can help identify key questions and details often overlooked.
acceptedAnswer.description: At a new construction sales center, review floor plans, finish samples, and model units, noting material quality and upgrade options. Ask about HOA fees and amenities, as standard inclusions might differ from model units.
